steps.say: Open excalidraw.com and you land on a blank canvas. No sign-up, no setup, just the toolbar.
Pick the text tool from the toolbar. Shapes, arrows, sticky notes and an eraser sit beside it.
Click anywhere on the canvas to start. The canvas is infinite, so there is room for the whole idea.
Type a line and it appears on the canvas. Your drawing autosaves in the browser.
